zap.imageDigestVerification: Before pulling/running ZAP, the runner compares the pinned digest to the official GHCR tag with Docker Buildx; a mismatch or unavailable check blocks DAST. No verification date is claimed here.

evidenceRetention: CI artifact; report JSON/SARIF/HTML is sanitized to omit source snippets and secret values
